description: This file defines a LayoutManager class responsible for managing graph layout algorithms, including integration with web workers, and handling different layout types such as Dagre and ELK. It includes methods for applying layouts, calculating node dimensions, and configuration management.

classes.name: LayoutManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing graph layout calculations, worker integration, and configuration.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the LayoutManager with optional configuration, sets up web worker if enabled.

methods.name: initializeWorker
methods.description: Creates and sets up the web worker for layout processing.

methods.name: handleWorkerMessage
methods.description: Handles messages received from the web worker, resolving or rejecting pending requests.

methods.name: rejectPendingWorkerRequests
methods.description: Rejects all pending worker requests with an error.

methods.name: disposeWorker
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up the web worker.

methods.name: applyLayoutWithWorker
methods.description: Sends layout request to web worker or falls back to main thread if worker is unavailable.

methods.name: isLargeGraph
methods.description: Determines if the graph is considered large based on node count.

methods.name: getAvailableLayouts
methods.description: Returns available layout types based on graph size.

methods.name: getDefaultLayout
methods.description: Returns default layout type based on graph size.

methods.name: isSlowLayout
methods.description: Checks if a layout type is slow for large graphs.

methods.name: getLayoutDescription
methods.description: Provides a textual description of a layout type.

methods.name: applyLayout
methods.description: Main method to apply a layout to nodes and edges, using worker or main thread.

methods.name: applyLayoutMainThread
methods.description: Applies layout calculations directly on the main thread.

methods.name: applyDagreLayout
methods.description: Performs Dagre layout with dynamic node spacing based on node dimensions.

methods.name: calculateNodeDimensions
methods.description: Calculates width and height of a node based on its data, considering text length and formatting.

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Updates configuration and manages worker state accordingly.
